WITH fiscal_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE
            WHEN ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-08-01' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 'FQ3'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter
    FROM orders
),
filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.fiscal_quarter,
        ol.amount_cents * ol.qty AS revenue_cents
    FROM fiscal_periods fp
    JOIN orders od ON fp.order_id = od.order_id
    JOIN order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE od.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
),
refunds_adjustment AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        SUM(refund_id.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.fiscal_quarter,
        SUM(fo.revenue_cents - COALESCE(ra.refund_cents, 0)) AS net_revenue_cents
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    LEFT JOIN refunds_adjustment ra ON fo.order_id = ra.order_id
    GROUP BY fo.fiscal_quarter
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_quarter,
    net_revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue
ORDER BY fiscal_quarter
